description: Use this when someone wants a person to learn from or talk to but has not named one yet: "who should I learn negotiation from", "find me a stoic to talk to", "which historical figures are worth asking about leadership". Returns a grid of real people rendered in the conversation, each with a portrait and a role. The person picks one to call.

category.description: Optional category filter. It must be one of the stored values listed here, for example "history-politics" or "science-tech". Leave it out and ask in words ("historical figures") if unsure.

limit.description: How many to return, 1 to 24. Defaults to 12.

query.description: Name or topic, for example "stoicism" or "Nietzsche".

name: find_someone_to_ask
title: Find someone to ask
